WYR_MessHallBodyguard_06
Lady Oberon's Bodyguard is a dragonborn battle master fighter who accompanies her mistress to the ordination  Enver Gortash as the Archduke of Baldur's Gate in Act Three.
“
You hear? M'lady says Absolute's army's on the march. Those Watchers will hold the line, you best believe.
„
— Lady Oberon's Bodyguard

Involvement

Lady Oberon's Bodyguard is in the mess hall, on the first floor of Wyrm's Rock Fortress. She accompanied her mistress,  Lady Freida Oberon and, while waiting for her lady to descend from Audience Hall, spends time chatting with the retinue of other patriars. She is engaged in casual conversation with  Lady Durinbold's Bodyguard, discussing the misfortunes of the Elturel tiefling exiles, and their fate in hands of  Ulder Ravengard and Gortash.

If spoken with afterwards, she expresses confidence in the Steel Watch, repeating her lady's opinion.

If the party confront Gortash, Lady Oberon's Bodyguard can be found along with all other invited guests and their retinue – slaughtered in the Audience hall.

Idle banter

  • Lady Oberon's Bodyguard
    Lady Alia says the Absolute's army won't be causing trouble for Gortash - or for us.
  • Lady Durinbold's Bodyguard
    I'm not sure I believe her, but does it really matter?
  • Lady Oberon's Bodyguard
    Meaning?
  • Lady Durinbold's Bodyguard
    Meaning that in the games of generals and dukes, we're not even pawns, just dust on the board.
  • Lady Durinbold's Bodyguard
    What happens next is out of our hands.
  • Lady Oberon's Bodyguard
    Gortash's got Ravengard on his side. That should tell you something.
  • Lady Durinbold's Bodyguard
    What? That every duke's just the same as the last, sticking up for each other as the sky falls around us?
  • Lady Oberon's Bodyguard
    Gods, it must be exhausting to be so cynical.
  • Lady Durinbold's Bodyguard
    Not as exhausting as all that boot-kissing you've been doing.
  • Lady Oberon's Bodyguard
    Ravengard's a hero! Elturel would still be stuck in the Hells if it weren't for him.
  • Lady Durinbold's Bodyguard
    Have you seen the tieflings at the south gate? Elturel's exiles, cast out by their own city.
  • Lady Durinbold's Bodyguard
    Your precious hero 'liberated' them from one hell only to trap them in another.
  • Lady Oberon's Bodyguard
    Shut your mouth. Ravengard is a legend.
  • Lady Durinbold's Bodyguard
    Ravengard is a charlatan. Like every last patriar of this wretched city.
